propositions: Task and story as direct children of the same epic cannot hold a direct blocking dependency because type-tier comparability incorrectly escalates to the epic, creating invalid ancestor-self-blocks

Blocking link resolution currently uses type tier (epic=2, story=1, task/bug=0) to determine comparable levels, but structural hierarchy—based on actual parent-child relationships—should determine comparability instead
The redundancy guard checks the original pair before resolution, so an escalated pair like E→S that is redundant can escape validation and be written to the store
Ancestor chains truncated at max_hops=2 force chain-root fallbacks that produce incorrect escalations; removing the cap and guarding against cycles fixes deep-hierarchy escalation

Blocking pairs whose resolved endpoints are ancestor-descendant must be rejected as redundant, whereas non-blocking relations (relates_to, supersedes) keep the original-pair redundancy check unchanged
Two parentless root tickets should be treated as siblings under a virtual sentinel, so cross-tree blocking links escalate to the real roots rather than being undefined
